name: erc20_patterns
description: Unsafe ERC-20 token integration without SafeERC20 or received-amount accounting
question: The source file in `source` contains code that calls an external ERC-20 token's transfer, transferFrom, or approve function directly (not via SafeERC20's safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom/forceApprove) and/or assumes the amount sent equals the amount received without measuring balances before and after, such that non-standard tokens (e.g., USDT-style no-return-value tokens, fee-on-transfer tokens, or rebasing tokens) can cause silent failures, reverts, or accounting errors that lead to fund loss or miscalculated balances.
criteria: Direct use of IERC20(token).transfer/transferFrom/approve without SafeERC20 wrapper
No balanceOf before/after check when crediting received token amounts after a transferFrom
Use of raw approve() instead of forceApprove() or safeApprove() for changing an existing non-zero allowance
Code that assumes decimals() == 18 or that decimals() always exists
Integration logic that stores/trusts raw token balances for rebasing tokens instead of shares
Missing check that token address is a contract before making calls to it
